name: Redacted Client Report and Citation Check
description: Prepares the redacted subject report and requires a human check that every statement cites case evidence.
legal_notes: Applies to verified self-audits and consent-based engagements. Results are leads, not facts; nothing is verified automatically. Every run re-checks the subject's authorization, and revoking it switches the schedule off.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: The citation check runs in the Reports screen; this workflow only enforces that a person performed it.
instructions: Prepares the redacted subject report and requires a human check that every statement cites case evidence.

config.prompt: Open Target profile > Reports. Generate the subject report preview, run the citation check, and confirm no speculative or sensitive associations are included.
